title: fix(storage)!: a record write naming a file its caller may not read is refused at the field
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XSuaEom6oxsAY7KX6uf4FcT)_

Fixes #26043

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What this changes

A record write that names a file its caller may not read used to save, keeping the id as written (#25951's "quiet answer"). The field then held a file it did not own, and every reader got an unusable value. That is the state ADR-0104's `verify-references` counts as blocking. Now the write is refused at the field.

- **The refusal** (`file-reference-lifecycle.ts`). Copy-on-claim judges every file a write names before it copies any, through the one lookup both halves of the claim path already share (`findReferenceableFile`). A file the caller may not read, or an id the acting organization cannot see, refuses its field. The write fails before the driver runs with one `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` whose `fields[]` has one ADR-0114 `invalid_value` entry per refused field. The entry names the field and its label only, never the file or the record that holds it. The two cases answer with the same body, so the write door cannot tell "may not read" from "does not exist in this organization".
- **One envelope, one recognition.** The refusal is built by the same helper as #26036's anonymous-write refusal, which is the form door's envelope (#25682). The form-submission door writes through the engine, so a submission naming such a file gets this answer too. No second copy of the judgement exists.
- **Order.** The read check runs first. A field that would pass is never copied when another field is refused, and constraint verdicts (`accept` / `maxSize`) never answer ahead of the read check.
- **Unchanged.** System writes and context-less programmatic writes keep their old behaviour, including keeping an id that names no file. A kernel with no read verdict bound asks nothing. An authorization-store outage still fails the write with its declared envelope. PR #26144's rule (a released file is judged by its former record) and PR #26036's rule (an anonymous write carries no file) are untouched.
- **Signed-link lifetime** (second commit, `storage-routes.ts`). A file governed by a record's rule now gets the record-governed link lifetime at the download door. The door and the read verdict read the same recognition (`releasingRecordOf` in `metadata-store.ts`). Who gets a link does not change.
- **A stale dogfood fixture** (third commit). The field-zoo HTTP round-trip wrote media ids that name no file, and so relied on the quiet answer. The first full dogfood run on this branch turned it red. It now uploads one real file per media field and asserts the read form carries that id. The matrix keeps its stored-shape stand-ins for the value-shape test.
- **ADR-0104.** The 2026-10-26 addendum's "quiet answer" item becomes "the field refusal", with an amendment line in the status block. It changes D3's text, so this PR is Tier H and stays draft for the maintainer.

**Envelope spelling.** The order and claim wrote `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`. They also say to match the #25682 form door and to carry an `invalid_value` entry. That door answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` with `fields[]`, and in this codebase `VALIDATION_ERROR` is the envelope with no `fields[]` (ADR-0104's 2026-10-19 note on D2). So this PR uses `VALIDATION_FAILED`, the form door's envelope, and says so here.

## Declarations

- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, measured on this diff: a record write naming a file its caller may not read, or an id no file of the organization has, used to save and is now refused. Nothing that was refused becomes accepted.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`: nothing a metadata author writes changes.
- One `patch` changeset on `@objectstack/service-storage`, `fix(storage)!:`, with the BREAKING section and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Tests

HEAD `c075544b6`.

- **Red first** on base `3993793dc` (the new pins, same files): 8 failed, 64 passed. That is the 7 refusal pins in `file-reference-read-verdict.integration.test.ts` and the 1 link-lifetime pin in `storage-routes.test.ts`. The controls (a system write still copies, a context-less write still keeps an unknown id) were green on base.
- `file-reference-read-verdict.integration.test.ts` (real `ObjectQL` + sqlite, `StorageServicePlugin` booted as shipped). It pins the whole refusal body with `toEqual` for a file owned by a record the writer cannot read, an attachments-scope file, a delegate refusal, an id that names no file, an update (the record keeps what it held), a multi-field write (nothing copied for the passing field), and a judgement fault. Each pin also checks that no record and no `sys_file` row was written.
- `file-reference-lifecycle.test.ts`: the #25692 unit pins move from "kept" to "refused". New pins: an unknown id gets the same body as an unreadable file, and every refused field is named in one answer.
- `file-reference-release-read-rule.integration.test.ts` (#26046): a write by a member refused the record is now `refused` instead of `kept`, under both collection settings.
- **Ablation** through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Disabling the refusal throw turns 27 tests red across the three files (blob `a9069ab6eba1` to `37aa77f91e7a`). Reverting the lifetime line turns the link-lifetime pin red (blob `95d899032bca` to `95bfe351ee89`). Both were restored, and the blob equals HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage test`: 66 files, 1226 tests passed. `typecheck` (including `check:test-typecheck`) passed. eslint `--no-inline-config` on `packages/services/service-storage/src`: clean.
- Full dogfood battery at HEAD: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 296 passed | 3 skipped (299), Tests 2523 passed | 18 skipped (2541). The first run, one commit earlier, was red in one file (`field-zoo-roundtrip.dogfood.test.ts`, the stale fixture above). After the fix that file and `field-zoo-value-shape.test.ts` pass 91/91, and the rerun at HEAD is the one quoted here.

## Gates

Local subset at HEAD `c075544b6`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 85 families from this diff. All 85 ran with exit 0, each code captured before any pipe, and `--ran` reconciles 85 run, 0 NOT MEASURED. One commit earlier, `check-comment-mask-corpus` hit a 300 s local timeout on the loaded box and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` answered exit 3 (shallow clone). Both were 0 on rerun, the latter after fetching its control commit, and both are 0 in the HEAD run. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage test` and `typecheck` ran one commit earlier, at `66398e79`. The last commit touches only two dogfood test files. Every other family is CI's, and this PR's check-runs are the record.

## Acceptance notes

- **A record that already holds such an id.** An update that sends back an id its caller may not read, or one that names no file, is refused like any other write. This includes the unchanged value of a record that got it under the quiet answer. The answer names the field, so the remedy is to clear it or name a readable file. Rows written under the quiet answer are the ones `verify-references` already reports.
- The second card the maintainer named in 「先改措辞,再批,另开两张卡」 is not addressed here.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:记录写入时,如果文件字段里填的是调用者无权读取的文件(或本组织里根本不存在的文件 id),现在直接在该字段上拒绝:返回 `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`,只点名字段,不暴露文件或其所属记录。以前(#25951)是"静默保留 id、保存成功"。另一个提交让受记录规则约束的文件,下载签名链接用记录级的短有效期。ADR-0104 2026-10-26 补记里"quiet answer"一条改写为"field refusal"。

**为什么改**:静默保留会让用户看到"保存成功但文件打不开",而这正是 ADR-0104 第 5 步 `verify-references` 判为阻断的状态。同类平台的做法也是直接拒绝挂接。这是你「先改措辞,再批,另开两张卡」里的第一张卡。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:这是收窄:以前能保存的这类写入现在被拒。系统写入和无上下文的程序写入不变,鉴权存储故障时仍按原信封失败。已经按旧规则存下悬空 id 的记录,再次带着该值更新时会被拒,需清空或换成可读文件。回滚即 revert 本 PR。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:审阅 ADR 那一条与修复,批准后合并(Tier H,保持 draft 等你)。
